title: HumanVideo-MME: Benchmarking MLLMs for Human-Centric Video Understanding
reasoning: The paper focuses on benchmarking multimodal large language models (MLLMs) on human-centric video understanding tasks like action recognition and causal reasoning. While 'Religious Ceremonies' is listed as one of the 50+ video scenario categories used for data collection, the benchmark does not evaluate religious knowledge, theology, ethics, or moral reasoning.
